title: Gesture-aware radius & spectral-accent presets for table actions
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Introduce a compact set of radius tokens mapped to common gesture sizes and a small spectral accent palette designed for table action controls. This work ties spacing/radius, color accents, and micro-shadow elevation together for high-density table rows and inline actions to improve tap targets, visual hierarchy, and accessibility across compact layouts. The goal is to provide token primitives designers and engineers can adopt with minimal layout churn.
acceptance_criteria: Defined radius tokens (r-XS, r-S, r-M) with explicit pixel values and recommended mapping for touch, pointer, and keyboard focus states.
A 4-shade spectral-accent palette (accent-default, accent-soft, accent-vivid, accent-neutral) with WCAG 2.1 AA contrast >= 4.5:1 against tokens.background for primary action text.
Updated Figma components for table row actions (menu, inline button, icon button) using new tokens and exported to the token library.
Code tokens exported into tokens-2026.03 release and a sample PR applying tokens to tables component is merged (see related artifacts).
Design QA and Accessibility review completed with remediation notes addressed.
decisions: Prefer small, direction-agnostic radius deltas to avoid changing component layout across breakpoints.
Provide separate radius tokens for interactive controls versus container cards to allow independent tuning.
Offer four spectral accents focused on perceptual spacing (soft/vivid/neutral) instead of an extended palette to reduce cognitive overhead for engineers.
Use slightly elevated micro-shadow for focused/pressed states only — avoid persistent elevated shadows in compact rows to reduce visual noise.

comments: 2026-03-01 - Asha Mehta: Kickoff. Scoped to table actions and inline buttons; excluded modal/primary buttons to avoid scope creep.
2026-03-03 - Liam O'Connor: Uploaded initial spectral-accent proposals to Figma (link below). Requested contrast tuning for accent-vivid on dark backgrounds.
2026-03-05 - Priya Nair (Accessibility): Flagged that accent-soft needs improved text contrast for small-cap buttons; recommending lighter background or stronger text color.

2026-03-07 - Sofia Martinez: Implemented radius samples in components file. Noted a minor layout regression on narrow table cells when using r-M; proposing conditional application based on density token.
2026-03-09 - Engineering review (ENG-22111): Recommended exporting tokens with kebab-case names and adding semantic aliases for legacy components. Also suggested telemetry events to track adoption.
2026-03-10 - Asha Mehta: Consolidated feedback and updated acceptance criteria. Preparing PR for tokens-2026.03.
notes: We intentionally limited the palette to four accents to keep engineering surface area small and to simplify A/B testing for quality regressions.
Next phase may broaden to include tokenized motion presets and density-aware elevation curves if adoption is positive.
